dedupe_keys.name: new business models for the circular economy of water a hybrid simulation study of a mobile rental wastewater treatment service

description: The hybrid model assesses a mobile wastewater-treatment rental service trialled in the Peloponnesian region of Greece. The source combines agent-based simulation, discrete-event simulation, system dynamics and multicriteria decision analysis. It considers customer composition, wastewater volume, logistics of mobile units and hubs, and staged investment in treatment capacity. A supplement identifies AnyLogic implementation screenshots and additional model materials. Screenshots establish the named implementation context but are not executable code. The model assesses commercialization scenarios; the metadata do not provide a quantitative investment recommendation, full inputs or a verified operational outcome. The source documents a water quality treatment or recovery study. The source authors provide this description through Zenodo, whose deposit declares CC BY 4.0 and public document access. Geographic and temporal coverage remain limited to the cases or observations explicitly described. Only metadata and file descriptors were reviewed; no document, measurements, model archive or code was read. Related components retain their source identities and uncertain experimental overlap. Document access and licensing do not establish executable availability or software rights.
